name: stefs-plugins
description: Stef's Claude Code plugins — the portable layer of software and project architecture conventions, plus general-purpose utilities.

plugins.name: arc-conventions
plugins.description: Nine skills carrying the portable layer of a project's software and project architecture conventions: how conventions themselves are recorded, plus SPA frontends, Terraform/AWS infrastructure, Go and Node Lambdas, MySQL, documentation, the glossary and product requirements. Every skill is model-invoked on topic match; the plugin registers no hooks and adds no executable code.

plugins.name: utils
plugins.description: General-purpose utility commands, skills and agents for Claude Code, including the default-on auto-summary-commit workflow: a pair of hooks offers a reviewed commit at the end of every turn that changed files, scoped to the paths that turn actually changed.
